high_level_description: This image captures a serene and picturesque scene of a woman standing inside a structure, gazing out at a vast desert landscape during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset. The sky is painted with hues of blue transitioning into warm oranges and pinks near the horizon, suggesting the time of day. The woman is positioned on the left side of the frame, facing away from the camera towards the desert. She is wearing a wide-brimmed hat, which shields her face from the sun, and glasses.
